objective: Generate musically compelling, controllable music through focused experiment labs sharing one Rust composition algebra, a composable musical ontology and contextual harmonic relationships.

checkpoint.summary: Harmonic Motion uses a generic Rust trajectory layer for exact member succession, whole-phrase contour costs and individual-line audition through CompositionPlan. Roman readings remain contextual interpretations or authored harmonic constraints. The tonal generator constructs 28 scale modes and bounded chord routes, then compares 24 complete voicings using explicit line continuity with a zero-strength baseline. Shared registered/periodic motion, chromatic entry and duration-weighted exposure support replacement and finite connecting routes. Up to three insertions subdivide a source bar while retaining anchor pitches, later onsets and member counts within endpoint bounds. Solos preserve actual rhythm and their emissions partition the full passage. These are authored forward strategies and bounded optima, not recovered voice identity, inferred passing roles or a complete counterpoint grammar. All labs retain the sole composition compiler.
nextActions: Audition complete phrases and their individual lines under matched harmonic constraints and explicit zero-continuity controls. Evaluate contour, motives, duration, inter-line motion, harmonic exposure and phrase destination separately; keep the chromatic descent and already-stepwise diminished controls.

Use persistent exact trajectory relationships as the foundation for composing from melodic intentions as well as harmonic constraints. Next evaluate joint phrase/correspondence search and richer rhythm or motive constraints against the current bounded voiced-reranking baseline; do not equate a small step-change penalty with a complete melody model.
If adding expectation, use a declared style/input tier and independent listener or repertoire evidence with work-lineage holdouts; hand-set costs remain compositional preferences.

Connect tuning and spectral premises only through a concrete compositional experiment. Preserve exact source coordinates and declare native rounding; roughness, functional stability and musical quality remain separate.

Keep future experiments isolated, retain the ontology's qualified vocabulary and lower useful relationships through CompositionPlan. Artist references guide musical goals, never hard-coded identities or fixed phrase lengths.

tasks.title: Grow experiments through the isolated lab contract
tasks.nextAction: Keep progression generation, chord explanations, structural replacement and audition in one focused session. Add future views through lazy modules and generated Rust contracts; consider durable persistence only with an explicit storage/version contract.

tasks.title: Evaluate contextual harmonic routes through complete passage edits
tasks.nextAction: Judge complete voice trajectories and their simultaneous harmonic context through audition and executable edits. Compare improved joint correspondence/phrase search with the declared 24-candidate voicing baseline before enlarging it. Preserve local connection optimality, line continuity, directed-anchor premises and inferred structural role as distinct claims.

tasks.title: Review composable musical vocabulary and relationships
tasks.nextAction: Use the generalized coordinate, spectrum and correspondence types to state complete musical intentions. Next evaluate shared generator coordinates, typed trajectories and resource-specific realization where they simplify a concrete composition task; do not add a universal parameter graph.

tasks.title: Make chosen musical intentions executable
tasks.nextAction: After the ontology step, choose a bounded combination of rhythmic material, pitch binding, voicing and expressive technique. Lower through the existing compiler and fail explicitly for unsupported realization; add no parallel decoder.

tasks.title: Develop and audition complete editable passages
tasks.nextAction: Demonstrate recognizable ideas, contrasting continuations, independent orchestration and useful shared/local edits. Evaluate listening quality separately from exact reconstruction and ontology coverage.

tasks.title: Infer reusable structure when composition needs it
tasks.nextAction: Use executable forward structures to frame complete-passage inverse tests with exact observations, explicit alternatives and counterfactual edits. Retain harmony benchmarks as diagnostics; resume calibration only when a concrete composition capability needs it. Preserve whole-work holdouts.
